info.title: Microstock+ Agent API
info.summary: Let AI agents manage a Microstock+ user's portfolio on the user's behalf.
info.description:
Contract: docs/AGENT_API_V1.md (Agent API v1).

- **An agent acts as the user, with less power.** Every call is scoped to the key owner's own account.
- **No deletion, ever.** No endpoint, scope or flag removes anything; any `DELETE` returns `405 deletion_not_supported`. Deleting stays manual in the web interface.
- **Money needs a human.** Paid actions need the `ai:run` scope (off by default), a quote first, and an `Idempotency-Key`.
- **Conventions.** JSON in and out; every object has `object`; times are ISO-8601 UTC; lists are `{object: "list", data, has_more, next_cursor}` with `cursor` and `limit` (1-200, default 50); every response has `x-request-id`.
- **Idempotency.** Send `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` on POST and PATCH; a repeat within 24 h returns the stored response with `idempotent-replayed: true`.
- **Rate limits per key.** 120 requests/min, 30 mutations/min, 2 concurrent streams; headers `x-ratelimit-limit-requests`, `x-ratelimit-remaining-requests`, `x-ratelimit-reset-requests`; `429 rate_limited` with `retry-after`.
- **Optimistic concurrency.** Every file has `metaver`; send `if_match_metaver` to get `409 metadata_conflict` instead of overwriting a newer edit.
- **Visibility.** Every change appears in the user's event feed and My Files, and is audited with the key prefix.

tags.name: ai
tags.description: AI keywording quotes, paid runs and jobs.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Event feed for near real-time progress.

get.description:
The key owner's account: plan, balance, connected agencies (with the ids used everywhere else), keyword settings, limits, and the calling key's name, prefix and scopes.

Required scope: `account:read`.

Folders as a flat list in path order, with file counts and per-agency status counts. Archived folders are excluded unless `archived=true`.

Required scope: `files:read`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: List the subfolders of this folder.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Include nested subfolders at every depth.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: `true` lists archived folders instead of active ones.

post.description: Creates one folder below an existing parent. Required scope: `files:upload`.

get.description:
Files in stable order (folder, then filename). `metadata.description` is left out unless `expand=metadata`.

Required scope: `files:read`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text matched against filename, title and keywords, or a comma-separated list of iids.

parameters.name: agency
parameters.description: Only files set up for this agency.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: With `agency`: only files in this status there.

parameters.name: missing
parameters.description: Comma-separated; files lacking any of these fields.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: `true` lists archived files instead of active ones.

get.description:
One file with full metadata, metaver, statuses and per-agency validation.

Required scope: `files:read`.

delete.description: There is no way to delete anything through the Agent API: every `DELETE` request on any path answers `405 deletion_not_supported`. Deleting stays a manual action in the Microstock+ web interface.

patch.description:
Changes only the fields present. Send `if_match_metaver` to get `409 metadata_conflict` instead of overwriting a newer edit. The change appears in the user's event feed. There is no undo button: to revert, write back the values read before the change.

Required scope: `metadata:write`.

post.summary: Patch up to 100 files (with dry run)
post.description:
Each item succeeds or fails on its own (per-item `error`). `dry_run: true` validates and returns the would-be files without writing anything.

Required scope: `metadata:write`.

post.summary: Set ready / queued / ignored per agency
post.description:
`queued` sends files to the agency (upload and submit). Only connected agencies; the Pond5 release guard and Microstock+ submission limits apply as in the web interface. Failures such as `nosubmissions` are per-item errors.

Required scope: `status:write`.

requestBody.description: Files, agencies and the status to set.

200.description: One result per file and agency.

post.description: Creates a chunk upload ticket for a local binary in an existing directory. Remote source URLs are not accepted. Required scope: `files:upload`.

Exports up to 500 files (from `iids` or a `folder`). With `Accept: text/csv` the CSV is returned directly instead of the export object.

Required scope: `csv:export`.

200.description: The export, or the CSV itself with `Accept: text/csv`.

get.description:
The `download_url` of an export. Works until `expires_at`.

Required scope: `csv:export`.

post.description:
Nothing is charged. Show the amount to the user; run the quote only after the user confirms it.

Required scope: `ai:quote`.

post.summary: Run a quoted AI keywording job (PAID)
post.description:
Charges the balance for files that succeed, at the quoted price. Needs the `ai:run` scope (off by default) and an `Idempotency-Key`; repeating the request with the same key returns the same job. Progress via `GET /jobs/{id}` or events.

Required scope: `ai:run`.

get.description:
Status, files done/failed and the amount charged so far.

Required scope: `files:read`.

Without `since`: the most recent events, oldest first. With `since`: events after that event. When nothing matches, waits up to `wait` seconds for a new matching event. Retention: 7 days.

Required scope: `events:read`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An event id, normally the previous `next_cursor`. Empty for the most recent events.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for a new event when none is available.

get.description:
Each event is sent as `id:`, `event: <type>` and `data: <event JSON>`; a heartbeat comment every 20 s. Resume with `Last-Event-ID`. At most 2 concurrent streams per key.

Required scope: `events:read`.

agentKey.description: An agent key created by the signed-in user at https://microstock.plus/ai-agent-skills (section "Agent keys"). `prefix` is 8 lowercase hex characters, `secret` 43 base64url characters. Each key carries scopes; cookies and session auth are ignored on this API.

RequestId.description: Request id, also in error bodies.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this key (120).

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when this is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A UUID. A repeat within 24 h returns the stored response with `idempotent-replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is `409 idempotency_mismatch`.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required for paid actions. A UUID; repeating the request with the same key within 24 h returns the stored response (the same job) instead of charging again.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request (`invalid_request_error`): invalid_json, missing_param, invalid_param, invalid_status, invalid_cursor, empty_value, title_too_long, keywords_too_many, invalid_combination, batch_too_large, export_too_large.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked key (`authentication_error`): invalid_api_key, revoked_api_key.

error.message: This agent key is not valid.
This key lacks the ai:run scope.

NotFound.description: Not found (`not_found_error`): file_not_found, folder_not_found, job_not_found, export_not_found, quote_not_found.

DeletionNotSupported.description: Deleting is never possible through the Agent API (`permission_error`, `deletion_not_supported`). Users delete files in the Microstock+ web interface.

error.message: Deleting is not available through the Agent API. Delete files in the Microstock+ web interface.

Conflict.description: Conflict (`conflict_error`): metadata_conflict, quote_expired, quote_used, invalid_status_transition, idempotency_mismatch.

error.message: The file changed: it is at metaver 8, not 7.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit reached (`rate_limit_error`, `rate_limited`): 120 requests/min, 30 mutations/min, 2 concurrent streams per key.

error.message: A file can have at most 50 keywords.

param.description: The request field the error is about, if any.

request_id.description: Same value as the `x-request-id` response header. Omitted on per-item batch errors.

FileStatus.description: Per-agency status. Stored: ready, ignored, queued, uploading, uploaded, uploadfailed, submitted, submitfailed, approved, rejected, approvalfailed. Derived for display: notready (validation errors), scheduled, cannotbequeued, nosubmissions (submission limit reached).

SettableStatus.description: `queued` sends the file to the agency (upload and submit).

external_id.description: The file's id at the agency, once uploaded.

uploaded_at.description: When the file was uploaded to the agency.

submitted_at.description: When the file was submitted for review.

errors.description: Upload or submission errors reported by the agency.

validation.description: Problems with the metadata for this agency. Reported, not enforced.

metaver.description: Metadata version; +1 on every change. Send it back as `if_match_metaver`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page.

status_summary.description: Per agency, the number of this folder's files in each status.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page.

balance_eur.description: Balance used for paid actions such as AI keywording.

agencies.description: Connected agencies. Use these ids everywhere (for example `adobestock` = Adobe Stock, `esp` = iStock).

MetadataPatch.description: Merge patch: only the fields present change. Keywords are trimmed, de-duplicated and lower-cased if the account setting says so.

title.description: At most 200 characters. `null` clears it; an empty string is rejected (`empty_value`).

description.description: Agency length limits (for example 200 characters on Shutterstock) are reported as validation, never cut. `null` clears it.

keywords.description: Change of keywords: either `set` (the complete new list) or `add` and/or `remove`. `set` cannot be combined with `add` or `remove`.

set.description: Replace all keywords with this list, most important first. An empty list removes all.

add.description: keywords to add after the existing ones.

ai_generated.description: `true` forces `editorial` to `false`; sending both as `true` is rejected (`invalid_combination`).

releases.description: Change of releases: either `set` (the complete new list) or `add` and/or `remove`. `set` cannot be combined with `add` or `remove`.

set.description: Replace all releases with this list. An empty list removes all.

add.description: releases to add after the existing ones.

title.description: At most 200 characters. `null` clears it; an empty string is rejected (`empty_value`).

description.description: Agency length limits (for example 200 characters on Shutterstock) are reported as validation, never cut. `null` clears it.

keywords.description: Change of keywords: either `set` (the complete new list) or `add` and/or `remove`. `set` cannot be combined with `add` or `remove`.

set.description: Replace all keywords with this list, most important first. An empty list removes all.

add.description: keywords to add after the existing ones.

ai_generated.description: `true` forces `editorial` to `false`; sending both as `true` is rejected (`invalid_combination`).

releases.description: Change of releases: either `set` (the complete new list) or `add` and/or `remove`. `set` cannot be combined with `add` or `remove`.

set.description: Replace all releases with this list. An empty list removes all.

add.description: releases to add after the existing ones.

if_match_metaver.description: Fail with `409 metadata_conflict` if the file's metaver differs.

dry_run.description: Validate and return the would-be files without writing anything.

file.description: The updated file, or with `dry_run` the would-be file (`ok: true` only).

error.description: Why this item failed (`ok: false` only); the item was not changed.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true for queued because it sends files to the agency.

StatusItemResult.description: One result per file and agency.

format.description: The layouts of Export CSV in My Files. Paid CSV formats are not in v1.

download_url.description: `GET` it with the same `Authorization` header before `expires_at`.

expires_at.description: When the download link stops working.

mode.description: `replace` rewrites the metadata of every file; `skip` leaves files that already have metadata unchanged and does not bill them.

template_id.description: One of the user's AI keywording templates; `null` for the default.

amount_eur.description: Maximum charge; only files that succeed are charged.

expires_at.description: The quote must be run before this time.

amount_eur_charged.description: Charged so far: files done × quoted price per file.

data.description: Depends on `type`: file.metadata.updated: iids, fields, count, folder; file.status.changed: iids, agency, from, to, count; file.uploaded and file.submitted: iids, agency, count; file.reviewed: iids, agency, result (approved or rejected), reason; ai.quote.created: quote_id, files, amount_eur; ai.job.started, ai.job.completed and ai.job.failed: job_id, files_total, files_done, files_failed, amount_eur_charged, error; export.ready: export_id, rows, format; key.created and key.revoked: key_prefix, key_name.

iids.description: Affected files (at most 50 are listed; see count).

has_more.description: More matching events are already available; call again at once.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `since` on the next call. It is the id of the last returned event, or of the newest event when none matched.
